This demonstration of fine-mapping will be done with the CACTA-like transposable element (TE) located on ZmPR4 as its exact position is known. Therefore we work with 2369 and LH123hT as both background parents and CML277 and CML341 as donor parents as they lack the TE which provide a higher expression of photoperiod-sensitivity. 

```{r get rp, dp, ZmPR list, echo=TRUE, message=T}

ZmPR_list <- 1
rp_list <- c(1, 2) #"2369", "LH123Ht"
# dp_list <-  c(3, 4) #"CML277", "CML341"
dp_list <-  c(1:7) #"CML277", "CML341"

```

# Genotype

We want to focus on lines belonging to group A (introgressed in the target region and nowhere else in the genome)

```{r load data, echo=TRUE, message=T}

groupA_NILs <- read.csv(paste0(genetic_data_save_path, "20240913Selected_NILs_after_filtration.csv"), header = T)

```

We keep only the genotypes introgressed in ZmPR 4 region (targeted region) and no other introgression in the background, meaning we work with NILs belonging to group A

```{r get the genotypes to work on}

### here all this should be done before this script 
geno_group <- groupA_NILs  %>%
      dplyr::mutate(rp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g[0-9]|i.*", "", entryid)),
                    dp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g|[0-9]i.*", "", entryid)), 
                    qtl = as.numeric(gsub(".*q|g.*", "", entryid))) %>%
      dplyr::filter(rp %in% rp_list) %>%
      dplyr::filter(dp %in% dp_list) %>% 
      dplyr::filter(qtl %in% ZmPR_list) %>%
      droplevels 

```

```{r manupilation of phenotypic data}

haplotype_slope <- read.csv(paste0(source_path, "haplotype_slope_20240921.csv"), header = T)

phenotype_zmpr4 <- haplotype_slope %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g[0-9]|i.*", "", haplotype)),
                dp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g|[0-9]i.*", "", haplotype)),
                qtl = as.numeric(gsub(".*q|g.*", "", haplotype))) %>%
  dplyr::rename(entryid2 = haplotype) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rp %in% rp_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dp %in% dp_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(qtl %in% ZmPR_list) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  dplyr::filter(entryid2 %in% unique(geno_group$entryid)) %>% ## keep only the NILs of group A
  dplyr::mutate(
    i = str_extract(entryid2, "i\\d+"),
    i = str_extract(i, "\\d{2}"),
    i = factor(
      i,
      levels = c(
        "12",
        "11",
        "10",
        "09",
        "08",
        "07",
        "06",
        "05",
        "04",
        "03",
        "02",
        "01"
      )
    )
  )

```

We transform the estimates so they are all positive, for that we apply a linear transformation by adding the absolute value of the most negative estimates to the other estimates. 

```{r manipulation of phenotypic data: define new estimate}

min_value <- phenotype_zmpr4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rp, dp) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(min_value = abs(min(Estimate, na.rm = T)))

phenotype_zmpr4 <- phenotype_zmpr4 %>% 
  dplyr::full_join(min_value) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample  = entryid2) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Estimate_transformed = Estimate + min_value, 
                Estimate_of_origin = ifelse(Estimate_transformed < min_value, 0, Estimate),
                Addition = ifelse(Estimate < 0, min_value - abs(Estimate) , min_value), 
                Sample = as.factor(Sample)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(Estimate_of_origin, Addition), 
                      names_to = "Type", 
                      values_to = "values") %>%
  # dplyr::arrange(desc(Estimate_transformed)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

pheno_tot <- sum(phenotype_zmpr4$Estimate_transformed, na.rm = T)

# sample_order <- dput(levels(reorder(phenotype_zmpr4$Sample, desc(phenotype_zmpr4$Estimate_transformed))))

```

## Fine map  

```{r define interval number and interval size}

# Number_interval = 200
# Interval_size = (max(calculation_file$i.end, na.rm =T) - min(calculation_file$i.start, na.rm =T)) /Number_interval

```

```{r extract the begin and end base paire of each interval}

get_segment <- function(difference) {
  seg <- integer(length(difference))
  seg[1] <- 1L

  for (i in 2:length(difference)) {
    seg[i] <- seg[i - 1]
    if (difference[i] > 0) {
      seg[i] <- seg[i] + 1L
    }
  }
  seg
}

```

```{r define the interval value}

dataframe_interval <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(calculation_file, as.factor(calculation_file$Sample)), function(x){
  print(unique(x$Sample))
  # x <- split(calculation_file,as.factor(calculation_file$Sample))[["NILASq3g12i09"]]
  
  x <- x %>%
    dplyr::mutate(geno = ifelse(is.na(geno), "NA", geno))

  x <- x[x$geno == "DP" | x$geno == "NA" | x$geno == "Het", ] ## to remove is there is missing 
    # print(x)

  if(nrow(x) == 0){ ## don't use the sample in the calcul for interval as it does not contains dp 
  }else{
  
  result <-  x%>%
    as.data.frame()%>%
    dplyr::group_by(geno) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(marker)  %>%
    dplyr::mutate( geno = ifelse(is.na(geno), "NA", geno), 
                   diff = if_else(
      dplyr::row_number() == 1,
      0,
      i.start - dplyr::lag(i.end)), 
             segment = get_segment(diff)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(segment, rp, dp, geno) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    begin = min(i.start, na.rm = TRUE),
    end   = max(i.end, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  }
}))
```

```{r define the interval value}

# Get mean size of segments in the targeted region of the NILs 
# mean_interval <- mean(calculation_file$dim_interval, na.rm =T)

# Define in which interval the segment falls 
dataset_final <- NULL
dataset_to_return <- NULL
table_for_fine_mapping <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    split(calculation_file, calculation_file$Sample),
    function(x) {
    # x <- split(calculation_file,as.factor(calculation_file$Sample))[["NILASq3g12i09"]]
      # rp <- 2
      # dp <- 6
      ## Run only if you want to get the interval per rp & dp 
      rp <- unique(x$rp)
      dp <- unique(x$dp)
      print((paste0("interval_list", "_", rp, "_", dp)))
      interval_list <- get(paste0("interval_list", "_", rp, "_", dp))
      
      # interval_list <- if (rp == 1) interval_list_rp1 else interval_list_rp2
      # begin_interval <- if (rp == 1) start_point_interval_ttest_rp1 else start_point_interval_ttest_rp2
      # end_interval <- if (rp == 1) end_point_interval_ttest_rp1 else end_point_interval_ttest_rp2

       dataset_final <- NULL
      # a <- 1
      
      for (i in 1:nrow(x)) {
            # print(i)

        # i <- 5  # remove after debugging

        dataset1 <- x[i, ]
        snp_start <- x$i.start[i]
        snp_end <- x$i.end[i]
        max_snp_end <- tail(x$i.end, 1)
        
        a <- 1
        interval_begin <- interval_list[[a]]
        interval_end <- interval_list[[a + 1]]
        end_max <- tail(interval_list, 1)
        
        # if(snp_start < begin_interval | snp_start > end_interval) {
        #   a <- NA
        #   dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
        #   dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)}
        if (snp_start < interval_end & snp_end > interval_end & snp_start < end_max ) {

          while (snp_end > interval_end) {
            a <- a + 1
            interval_begin <- interval_list[[a]]
            interval_end <- interval_list[[a + 1]]
          }

          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        } else if (snp_start >= interval_end & snp_start < end_max) {

          while (snp_start >= interval_end) {
            a <- a + 1
            interval_begin <- interval_list[[a]]
            interval_end <- interval_list[[a + 1]]
          }

          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        } else if (snp_end == max_snp_end & max_snp_end < end_max) {

          a <- length(interval_list)
          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        } else if (snp_end > end_max) {

          a <- NA
          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        } else {

          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        }

      }

      dataset_final
    }
  )
)
```

```{r exclude beginning and end interval where there are NA genotypes}
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(start_point = min(i.start, na.rm =T))

start_point_interval_ttest <- max(unique(start_point_sample$start_point))

end_point_sample<- calculation_file %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(end_point = max(i.end, na.rm =T))

end_point_interval_ttest <- min(unique(end_point_sample$end_point))
```

```{r calculate the value of the interval}


### Alternative test interval value per rp and dp
table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content_all <- NULL
for (rp in rp_list){
  for(dp in dp_list){
    # dp <- 3
    # rp <- 2
    # start_end_ttest <- start_end_ttest %>%
    #   as.data.frame() %>%
    #   dplyr::filter(rp == rp & dp == dp)
    # 
    table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content <- table_for_fine_mapping %>%
      dplyr::filter(rp == rp & dp == dp) %>%
      dplyr::filter(i.start > start_point_interval_ttest &
                  i.end < end_point_interval_ttest) %>%
      # dplyr::filter(
      #   i.start > start_end_ttest$start_point_interval_ttest &
      #     i.end < start_end_ttest$end_point_interval_ttest
      # ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Sample, interval) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        RP = sum(geno == "RP") / n(),
        DP = 1 - RP,
        i.start = min(i.start),
        i.end = max(i.end)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample, rp, dp, RP, DP, interval, i.start, i.end) %>% 
      dplyr::distinct() ## normal because several marker within an interval 
    
    table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content_all <- rbind.data.frame(
      table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content,
      table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content_all
    ) %>%
      distinct()

  }}

interval_for_plotting_rp_dp <- table_for_fine_mapping %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(interval, rp, dp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(i.start = min(i.start, na.rm =T))
```

```{r extract p-val associated to the interval}


## Alternative analysis by rp and dp
ttest_pval_separate_rp <- NULL
for (a in rp_list){
  for(b in dp_list){
    # a <- 2
    # b <-4
    # interval_with_DP <- get(paste0("interval_with_DP_", rp, dp))

    print( a, b )

    Sample <- subset(table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content_all, rp == a &
                       dp == b)
    Sample <-      unique(droplevels(Sample$Sample))


    interval_with_DP <- table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content_all %>%
      dplyr::filter(rp == a & dp == b) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(interval) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(sum_DP = sum(DP, na.rm = T),
                       sum_RP = sum(RP, na.rm = T)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(sum_DP == 0 |
                      sum_DP == 1 |
                      sum_RP == 0 |
                      sum_RP == 1 | sum_DP < 1 |  sum_RP < 1) %>% dplyr::select(interval)

    assign(paste0("interval_with_DP_", rp, dp), interval_with_DP)

    ttest_pval_rp1 <- table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content_all %>%
      dplyr::filter(rp == a & dp == b) %>%
      droplevels() %>%
      dplyr::full_join(phenotype_zmpr4[, c("Sample", "Estimate_transformed")] %>%
                         dplyr::distinct()) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = RP:DP,
                          names_to = "geno",
                          values_to = "geno_value") %>%
      dplyr::filter(geno_value != 0 &
                      !(interval %in% unique(interval_with_DP$interval)) &
                      Sample %in% Sample) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(interval, rp, dp)

    if(nrow(ttest_pval_rp1) > 0){

    ttest_pval_rp1 <- ttest_pval_rp1 %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        pval = t.test(Estimate_transformed ~ geno)$p.value,
        .groups = "drop",
        var.equal = FALSE
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(pval_adjusted = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"))
    }else{ ## here add NA if the test can't be run e.g. 0, 1 or 2 NILs only
      ttest_pval_rp1 <- data.frame(interval = NA, rp =c(a), dp = c(b), pval = NA, var.equal = NA, pval_adjusted = NA)
    }

ttest_pval_separate_rp <- rbind.data.frame(ttest_pval_separate_rp, ttest_pval_rp1)

}}


### mode with lm instead of t-test
lm_pval_separate_dp_rp <- NULL
for (a in rp_list){
  for(b in dp_list){
    # a <- 2
    # b <-5
    print( c(a, b ))

    Sample <- subset(table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content_all, rp == a &
                       dp == b)
    Sample <- (unique(Sample$Sample))


    interval_with_DP <- table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content_all %>%
      dplyr::filter(rp == a & dp == b) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(interval) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(sum_DP = sum(DP, na.rm = T),
                       sum_RP = sum(RP, na.rm = T)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(sum_DP == 0 |
                      sum_DP == 1 |
                      sum_RP == 0 |
                      sum_RP == 1 | sum_DP < 1 |  sum_RP < 1) %>% dplyr::select(interval)

    assign(paste0("interval_with_DP_", rp, dp), interval_with_DP)

lm_pval <- table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(rp == a & dp == b) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(phenotype_zmpr4[, c("Sample", "Estimate_transformed")] %>%
                  dplyr::distinct()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = RP:DP,
                      names_to = "geno",
                      values_to = "geno_value") %>%
  dplyr::filter(geno_value != 0 &
                  !(interval %in% unique(interval_with_DP$interval)) &  Sample %in% Sample) %>%
  # dplyr::group_by(interval) %>%
  # dplyr::mutate(rp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g[0-9]|i.*", "", Sample)),
  #               dp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g|[0-9]i.*", "", Sample)), 
  #               rp = as.character(rp), 
  #               dp = as.character(dp), 
  #               geno_value = round(as.numeric((geno_value)))) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  split(.$interval) %>%
purrr::map(function(x)  if(nrow(x)>1){
  # x <-  ttest_pval$`124`
predictors <- c("geno", "rp", "dp", "geno:rp", "geno:dp", "rp:dp")

formula_model <- stats::reformulate(
  predictors,
  response = "Estimate_transformed"
)
  # Retirer rp ou dp si la variable est invariable
  if (dplyr::n_distinct(x$rp, na.rm = FALSE) <= 1) {
    predictors <- setdiff(predictors, c("rp", "geno:rp", "rp:dp"))
  }

  if (dplyr::n_distinct(x$dp, na.rm = FALSE) <= 1) {
    predictors <- setdiff(predictors, c("dp", "geno:dp",  "rp:dp"))
  }

  # Construire la formule avec les variables restantes
  formula_model <- stats::reformulate(
    predictors,
    response = "Estimate_transformed"
  )

  model <- stats::lm(formula_model, data = x)

  # Extraire la p-value associée à geno
  summary(model)$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Pr(>|t|)"]
}else{
as.list(structure(list(NA), names = interval) ) }) %>% 
 map_dfr(., ~ as.data.frame(.x), .id = "interval") %>%
dplyr::mutate(pval_adjusted = if(nrow(.) >0) {p.adjust(.x,method="BH")}, 
              interval = if(nrow(.) >0) as.numeric(interval), rp =c(a), dp = c(b))

lm_pval_separate_dp_rp <- rbind.data.frame(lm_pval_separate_dp_rp, lm_pval)

  }}
```
